Application Data.NAME: ABC Office Supplies LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Office Supplies LLC is engaged in the retail and distribution of office supplies and equipment, including office furniture, stationery, and computer accessories. We operate primarily from our physical storefront located at 123 Main Street, Suite 100, Springfield, IL, with a strong emphasis on customer service and in-store sales. Our inventory is valued at approximately $400,000, and we have implemented an operational, professionally monitored alarm system to safeguard our assets. Additionally, the majority (about 60%) of our sales are conducted in-store, which helps mitigate risks associated with online transactions. We offer limited repair services, accounting for less than 10% of our total revenue, and maintain comprehensive operational practices to ensure quality control and customer satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a theft incident occurred at our storefront, resulting in a loss of office supplies valued at $5,000. The stolen items were primarily stationery and small electronic devices. The incident was reported to local law enforcement, and a theft report was filed; however, recovery of the items was unsuccessful. As a result, the claim was settled with an insurance payout of $5,000. The claim has been marked as closed. Since then, we have improved our security measures by upgrading our alarm system to a more advanced, professionally monitored service, ensuring better protection against future incidents.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class 3, Grade B, 2-Hour Fire Rating, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the premises, along with regular patrols by a licensed security company during non-business hours.
